'''Senior control [[Technician/Legends|technician]]''' was a staff position under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the time surrounding the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]], [[B'wuf]] held this position.
